[[File:Mos_Espa_Produce.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] produce: spicy ahrisa, [[Lamta/Legends|lamta]], [[Haroun bread/Legends|haroun bread]], [[Sidi gourd/Legends|sidi gourd]], [[Tezirett seed/Legends|tezirett seed]] and [[Driss/Legends|driss]] pod]]
{{Quote|At least the food is good, this is the best I ever tasted.|[[Cholly]], eating spicy ahrisa at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Didi's Café]]|<ref name="TDR">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dangerous Rescue]]''</ref>}}
'''Ahrisa''' was a spicy food made of greens and [[soypro]]. Usually served in small portions, rolled into a ball and eaten with bread. It was served in many cafes on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. It was also available at the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] marketplace on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] served ahrisa to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his companions.
